parameters.name: CloudProvider
parameters.description: The cloud provider of the instance.

parameters.name: DBClusterIds
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster. You can specify multiple cluster IDs, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
